description: Land Title Settlement Department - Lunuwila, Wennappuwa D/S Division, Puttlam District  - Cad. Map No. 410001
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extent, owners, and encumbrances) in various villages. The content focuses on land ownership, title registration, and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
